mapper.select: select di.name, sum(coalesce(di.amount, 0) * coalesce(oi.quantity, 1)) as amount, di.unit, di.category, group_concat(distinct oi.dish_id order by oi.dish_id separator ',') as source_dish_ids from personal_order po inner join order_item oi on oi.order_id = po.id inner join dish_ingredient di on di.dish_id = oi.dish_id where po.family_id = #{familyId} and po.meal_session_id = #{mealSessionId} and po.deleted = 0 and po.status in ('CONFIRMED', 'COOKING', 'COMPLETED') group by di.name, di.unit, di.category order by di.category asc, di.name asc
